signals.topic: AI meeting notes pricing tier jump

insights.statement: v3.0.0 raised team plan pricing from $14/seat to $29/seat.
Mid-market buyers are voicing price sensitivity across multiple communities.
Japanese transcription accuracy keeps a defensive premium segment despite the price jump.
Validate a localized Japanese retention offer before expanding globally.
insights.action: Design a JP-locale grandfathering offer and pilot for 4 weeks.
